headline: Executive order changes earlier presidential orders about certain official certificates and badges.
what_it_does: This order amends one or more earlier executive orders that deal with certain government certificates and badges. The title does not say which certificates or badges are covered or what exactly changes. No summary was provided, so the specific effects are not clear.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 20, 2024; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
